Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment consists of two parts: N-glycomics (analyzing released glycans) and glycoproteomics (analyzing GNL-enriched glycoproteins). The routing focuses on the glycoproteomics workflow which used DDA and lectin-based enrichment for paucimannosidic N-glycans.

scope: GC samples analyzed by N-glycomics (12 out of 13) were submitted to lectin-based enrichment to identify putative carriers of paucimannosidic N-glycans.
Total protein extracts were resuspended in GNL buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.5, 0.15 M NaCl, 0.1 mM CaCl2) and 200 μg were loaded on agarose-bound GNL for enrichment (Vector Laboratories).
After washing the column 10 times with GNL buffer, the glycoproteins were eluted with 3% acetic acid (100 μL for 3 times) and dried in speedvac.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis specifically utilized GNL lectin-based enrichment to isolate glycoproteins from total protein extracts before LC-MS/MS. While the results mention that identified proteins were primarily of intracellular origin (ribosomal proteins), this describes the identity of the captured proteins rather than a pre-analytical subcellular fractionation step.
